title: Measure right work, not just more work
look: Session board: counters, an activity chart, two paired metric cards and the metric groups on a dot-grid desk. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for rework, jade for work that landed. The Sensei mark on the close.

scenes.name: More
scenes.desc: Tokens, commits and lines count up. Is any of it right?

scenes.name: Busy
scenes.desc: A bad week looks busier than a good one: fixing things is activity too.

scenes.name: The pair
scenes.desc: First-turn resolution and rework share, read together: high resolution with rising rework means work deferred, not done.

scenes.name: Grouped
scenes.desc: Sensei groups metrics by outcome, quality, velocity, usage and cost, and shows velocity next to its quality companion.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: measure right work, not more work.
